items.t: Sudden power loss or stalling with electrical glitches
items.note: One dealer quoted about $990 for an alternator and new battery cables.

items.t: Key gets stuck in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder or shifter Park switch
items.note: RepairPal lists about $225-$300 for 2012-2013 and up to about $730 in other listings.

items.t: StabiliTrak, traction and ABS warning lights
Power steering fluid reservoir can leak (recall)
Charging light on and alternator failure

items.note: RepairPal total is about $400-$450. Scan first; the passenger seat sensor can also be the cause.

items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner (2.4L)
items.note: Parts: about $100-$200 for an aftermarket set; GM chain, tensioner and guides list near $400. Book time is 4.9 hours; one owner was quoted 7 hours and about $1,200-$1,500. 8020 Automotive puts a stretched-chain job at $1,000-$1,500 total. If the chain jumped and bent valves, it costs much more.

items.t: Brakes grab or a caliper sticks
items.note: Based on YourMechanic, which averages about $190 parts and $250 labor ($443 total) for one caliper; its front-caliper quotes run about $645, with shop/dealer prices of $744-$1,034. Hours are converted from its labor cost. New pads or a brake hose may add to it.
